scope: Offline stability and correctness review; no additional live model requests

ocrRegressions.bannerLikeRecognizedText: Old readOneResult discarded a complete valid JSON response if its recognized text contained init completed; regression now preserves both single-line and pretty-printed results.
ocrRegressions.engineStatuses: 100 parses data only, 101 is a successful empty image, 200+ returns a status-only error instead of treating diagnostics as text.
ocrRegressions.deadline: Worker timeout preserves context.DeadlineExceeded so desktop does not launch another fallback after the deadline; pre-write cancellation retains a healthy worker.
ocrRegressions.readingOrder: A fixed row anchor replaces a non-transitive pairwise sort; staggered row permutations produce the same reading order.

oneShotUnicodeTemp.method: Production NewRapidOCR.ExtractResult, bundled engine, synthetic narrow PNG, TEMP/TMP containing Chinese, spaces and emoji
oneShotUnicodeTemp.interpretation: Correctness fix, not a speed comparison: original run failed; successful cold-start time includes initialization. Pinned bundled engine now uses one single-use pipe worker, custom executable CLI behavior is preserved.

persistentQualityRecheck.method: Same six synthetic fixtures and stock reference JSON, two passes through production Worker, complete normalized text and boxes must match; background unit-test load was present
persistentQualityRecheck.interpretation: Quality and compatibility regression only; this is not a controlled latency comparison with previous builds.

httpCompletedTail.method: Local httptest returns a valid finish_reason=stop and leaves its body open; no model involved
httpCompletedTail.before: Waited until the two-second parent deadline and failed
httpCompletedTail.interpretation: Applies to OpenAI-compatible HTTP streaming; not a Codex model generation speed claim.
